\section{Occupations}
Energies are measured from the chemical potential, where $\xi = \epsilon - \mu$, and $\beta>0$.
\section{Hyperbolic form}
In this section we switch to the dimensionless energy,
\begin{equation}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta(\epsilon-\mu)}+1} = \frac{1}{2}\left(1-\tanh\frac{\beta\xi}{2}\right), \qquad \xi \equiv \frac{\beta(\epsilon-\mu)}{2} .
\label{eq:tanh}
\end{equation}
